title: The last page of a category is missing
prompt: A category with 25 products shows 'page 1 of 2' and the pager stops at page 2, so the last 5 products can never be reached. Fix it.
notes: One expression in page_count: division that rounds up. The lazy-wrong fix adds 1, which invents an empty extra page whenever the count divides evenly. A control: there is no room to over-build, and the hidden test allows two changed lines of code.
extension: Hide the pager when everything fits on one page: add `needs_pager(total, per_page)`.
